items.text: Oluyimba lwa Sulemaani olusinga ennyimba zonna.
Kabaka ansembezezza kumpi nnyo antutte mu bisenge bye.
era tunaatendereza okwagala kwo okusinga envinnyo.
Ntegeeza ggwe gwe njagala, gy'oliisiza ekisibo kyo,
ne gy'owumuliza endiga zo mu ssaawa ez'omu ttuntu.
Bw'oba nga tomanyi, ggwe omukyala asinga bonna obulungi,
nkugeraageranya n'embalaasi esika amagaali ga Falaawo.
Amatama go galabika bulungi ng'oyambadde ebikomo eby'oku matu,
n'ensingo yo nerabika bulungi ng'erimu eby'omu bulago eby'omuwendo.
Kabaka bwe yali ng'atudde ku mmeeza ye,
Muganzi wange ali ng'ensawo eya kaloosa aka mooli
Muganzi wange ali ng'ekiganda eky'ebimuli ebya kofera
ebivudde mu nnimiro ez'emizabbibu ez'e Engedi.

items.text: Ndi kimuli kya looza ekya Saloni,
gwe njagala ennyo bw'ali bw'atyo mu baweereza abakazi.
Omukono gwe ogwa kkono guli wansi wa mutwe gwange,
Omwagalwa wange ali ng'empeewo oba ennangaazi ento.
alabikira mu mulimu ogulukibwa ogw'omu ddirisa.
n'emizabbibu gimulisizza ne gibunya akawoowo kaagyo.
Ggwe ejjiba lyange, eribeera mu njatika ez'omu njazi,
Muganzi wange, wange nzekka, era nange ndi wuwe;
oba ennangaazi ento ku busozi obw'e Beseri.

items.text: Ekiro kyonna nga ndi ku kitanda kyange,
mu nguudo ne mu bifo ebigazi;
abaali balawuna mu kibuga, ne bansisinkana, ne mbabuuza nti,
ne ndaba oyo emmeeme yange gw'eyagala.
okutuusa lwe namuleeta mu nnyumba ya mmange,
ne mutwala mu kisenge ky'oyo eyanzaala.
Ani oyo ajja ng'ava mu ddungu,
buli omu n'ekitala kye mu kiwato kye,
ne wansi waakyo nga wa zaabu,
n'entebe yaamu ng'eriko olugoye lwa ffulungu;
ne munda nga mwaliire bulungi n'okwagala,
mulabe ku Kabaka Sulemaani ng'ayambadde engule,
ku lunaku omutima gwe kwe gwasanyukira.

items.text: Ng'olabika bulungi, gwe njagala, laba ondabikidde bulungi.
Amaaso go mayiba mu lugoye mw'ogabisse.
Amannyo go gali ng'ekisibo ky'endiga nga kye zijje zisalibweko ebyoya,
Buli emu nnongo eri n'ennongo ginnaayo,
Emimwa gyo giri ng'ewuzi ey'olugoye olutwakaavu;
Ensingo yo eri ng'omulongooti gwa Dawudi,
ne ku gwo nga kuliko engabo lukumi,
Amabeere go gombi gali ng'abaana b'empeewo,
ndigenda ku lusozi olunene olwa mooli
Jjangu tuve mu Lebanooni, omugole wange,
Lengera okuva ku ntikko ya Amana,
n'okuva ku ntikko ya Seniri ne ku ntikko ya Kerumooni,
otutte omutima gwange, ne munye y'eriiso lyo gy'onkubye,
Ng'okwagala kwo kulungi mwannyinaze, omugole wange,
okwagala kwo nga kusinga nnyo envinnyo,
n'akawoowo ak'amafuta go kasinga eby'akawoowo eby'engeri zonna obulungi.
Emimwa gyo gitonnya obuwoomi ng'ebisenge eby'omubisi gw'enjuki, omugole wange;
amata n'omubisi gw'enjuki biri wansi w'olulimi lwo.
Akaloosa ak'ebyambalo byo kali ng'akawoowo ak'e Lebanooni.
Oli nnimiro eyasimbibwa, mwannyinaze, omugole wange,
Muleke muganzi wange ajje mu nnimiro ye,

items.text: Nzize mu nnimiro yange mwannyinaze, omugole wange;
Ndidde ebisenge byange eby'omubisi gw'enjuki gwange ne nywa n'omubisi gwange,
Abemikwano mulye munywe, munywere ddala, mmwe abaagalana.
Ne mpulira muganzi wange ng'akonkona, n'ayogera nti,
nnaddayo ntya mu ttaka gye binaddugalira?
Muganzi wange bwe yakwata ku munyolo,
Omutima gwange gwasanyuka bwe nnawulira eddoboozi lye.
Ne munoonya naye n'ambula, ne mukoowoola naye nga taddamu.
bwe baali nga balawuna mu kibuga;
mbakuutira nti bwe mulaba ku muganzi wange,
kyasinza abalungi abalala ggwe omukazi akira abalala obulungi?
Muganzi wange alabika bulungi nnyo era mumyufu,
Omutwe gwe gwa zaabu ennongoose ennyo;
Emikono gye giri ng'emitayimbwa egya zaabu
Amagulu ge gali ng'empagi ez'amayinja aganyirira
Ono ye muganzi wange, ye mukwano gwange;

items.text: Muganzi wange aserengese mu nnimiro ye,
Muganzi wange, wange, nange ndi wuwe;
buli emu nnongo eri n'ennongo ginnaayo,
Ne bwe walibeerawo bakabaka abakazi nkaaga,
ejjiba lyange, owange ataliiko bbala, ow'enjawulo,
mwana muwala eyazaalibwa yekka, ayagalibwa ennyo nnyina
Abawala baamulaba ne bamuyita wa mukisa;
Naserengeta mu nnimiro ey'emiti egy'ensigo okwetegereza
emmeeme yange n'egenda eri amagaali ag'obwakabaka ag'omu bantu bange.

items.text: Ebigere byo nga birabika bulungi mu ngatto,
Amaaso go gali ng'ebidiba eby'omu Kesuboni
Ennyindo yo eri ng'omulongooti ogw'e Lebanooni
n'amabeere go gali ng'ebirimba eby'ebibala byakwo.
Amabeere go gabeere ng'ebirimba eby'oku muzabbibu,
n'akawoowo ak'omu kamwa ko ng'ebibala eby'omucungwa
n'akamwa ko nga nvinnyo esinga obulungi.
Ne wayini amirwe bulungi muganzi wange,
ng'akulukuta mpola mpola ku mimwa gy'abo abeebase.
Jjangu, muganzi wange tugende ebweru w'ekibuga,
era eyo gye nnaakulagira okwagala kwange.
ne ku miryango gyaffe waliwo ebibala ebisinga obulungi,

items.text: Singa wali muganda wange eyakuzibwa mmange
ne nkuleeta mu nnyumba ya mmange,
Omukono gwe ogwa kkono guli wansi wa mutwe gwange
Ani oyo gwe tulengera ng'ava mu ddungu
Eyo maama wo gye yafunira olubuto era eyo
maama wo gye yakuzaalira mu bulumi obungi.
Amazzi amangi tegamalaawo nnyonta ya kwagala
obugagga bwe bwonna obw'ennyumba ye okufuna okwagala,
Sulemaani yalina ennimiro y'emizabbibu e Baaluka Kamooni,
ebitundu ebikumi bibiri by'abo abalabirira ennimiro.
